outlets.name: Signal Akron (nonprofit newsroom) — Best of the City reader vote
outlets.credible: Akron's nonprofit newsroom (Signal Ohio network); runs an annual reader-voted Best of the City (2024–2026) with per-winner write-ups and addresses — a real popularity vote, plus bylined food features.
